blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu City schools will decide whether to suspend face-to-face classes when the Air Quality Index (AQI) reaches 150 to 199, while class suspensions will become automatic once readings hit 200, Mayor Nestor Archival said on Friday.
